title: Landscape analysis for shallow neural networks: Complete classification of critical points for cubic activation and affine target functions
summary: In this paper, we study the optimization landscape induced by the true loss for shallow polynomial neural networks (PNNs) with $\mathfrak{h} \in \mathbb{N}$ neurons on the hidden layer, one-dimensional input and output layers, and a monomial activation of degree $d \in \mathbb{N}$, trained against a non-constant affine linear target function. Our first main result provides for arbitrary activation degree $d$ a sharp existence/non-existence criterion for \emph{global minimizers} with necessary structural conditions.
